Just a name for your teammates. It stays: Just a name for your teammates. It stays on this browser, and you can change it anytime. Updates apply to the next tunnel you join.

Gap forwards your content through a Sock: Gap forwards your content through a Socket.IO server. The server keeps room membership and transfer metadata in memory, but never saves messages or file contents to a database or disk. New arrivals only see content shared after they join.
Your current device keeps the latest 150: Your current device keeps the latest 150 shared items in memory while connected. Leaving, losing connection, or ending the tunnel clears that device’s content and file URLs. When the last person leaves, the room disappears immediately. Every tunnel also expires after two hours.
Anyone with the invite link, code, or QR: Anyone with the invite link, code, or QR can join until the tunnel is full. Share invites with people you trust. Any participant can end the tunnel for everyone. There are no public room listings or accounts.
LocalStorage remembers only your display: LocalStorage remembers only your display name, theme, and interface language. Messages, files, invite codes, and tunnel history are never written to LocalStorage. You can clear your name in preferences at any time.
Gap is a server relay, not end-to-end en: Gap is a server relay, not end-to-end encrypted. Use HTTPS when deploying to encrypt network traffic. People can download files, copy messages, or take screenshots; Gap cannot erase copies they choose to keep. Hosting infrastructure may record connection metadata according to its configuration.
Choose “Just us two” for a private pair: Choose “Just us two” for a private pair or “The whole team” for up to 12 people. Give yourself a display name if you like. No account, password, or sign-out needed.
Copy the invite link, send the 12-charac: Copy the invite link, send the 12-character code, or let someone scan the QR with their camera. On the same Wi-Fi, open Gap using the computer’s local network address so other devices can reach it. A localhost link works only on the computer that opened it.
Once a second person joins, send message: Once a second person joins, send messages, links, code snippets, images, and any file up to 20 MB. You can attach or drag files into the tunnel. Files travel in small chunks; the progress bar shows the transfer.
Leave to clear this device, or end the t: Leave to clear this device, or end the tunnel to clear it for everyone. A tunnel disappears when everyone leaves and expires after two hours. Rejoining starts fresh; there is no saved history to restore.
